meta.title: About: a small agency, on purpose
meta.description: Sansara Media is Miguel and Christiane. Two people, ten years in marketing, building client acquisition systems for businesses that get booked directly.

hero.title: Two people. Small on purpose.
hero.lead: Sansara Media is Miguel and Christiane. We build the systems that bring clients to businesses where people book you directly, and we do the work ourselves.

sections.title: What ten years taught us
body: Single pieces rarely change a business. A nice landing page here, one clever campaign there. It helps, then it fades, because everything around it is still held together by hand.

We saw it again and again: owners doing everything they were told to, posting, replying fast, following up, and still chasing. Not because they weren't working hard enough. Because all of it ran through them.
So we stopped selling pieces as if they were answers, and started building the whole path, connected, and handing it over working.

sections.title: Why we stay small
body: When you work with us, you work with us. There is no account manager between you and the people doing the work, and nobody learning on your budget.
Small also means we take on only a few businesses at a time, and only when we think it will work. If it won't, we'll tell you on the first call.

sections.title: Where the name comes from
body: Sansara is the cycle: things coming round again. It's what we build. Not a one-off burst of attention, but a loop that keeps bringing the right people in, keeps in touch with them, and brings the good ones back.

values.title: Done for you
values.text: We build, connect and launch it. You never touch the tech.

values.title: Plain words
values.text: If we can't say it simply, we don't say it.

values.title: Honest fit
values.text: If it's not right for you, we'll tell you.

values.title: Yours to keep
values.text: Ad account, page, list and data are in your name from day one. If you ever leave, you leave with all of it.

final.title: Talk to the two people who'd do the work.
final.text: Thirty minutes, free. We look at your business together and tell you honestly what we'd do, and whether you need us for it.
